steps.title: Fit the lower link to the bare motor
steps.text: Prepare this pair off the knee. Align the locating pegs with the case before tightening.
steps.pathStatus: Original lower/motor nominal contact retained; this step is not a strict zero-overlap certificate.

steps.title: Fasten the two case corners
steps.text: Use the existing two case screws; the new bracket is still off.

steps.title: Place the metal rear washer
steps.text: Put the existing 0.5 mm metal washer at the rear centre. It is separate from the black printed sleeve.

steps.title: Retain the rear centre
steps.text: Use the original rear-centre screw through that washer. Keep hand snug.

steps.title: Slide on the new black sleeve
steps.text: The new 10.4 mm bore clears the nominal 10 mm boss. The sleeve can float; do not glue it or force a press fit.

steps.title: Bring the complete pair into the open base
steps.text: With the removable cheek off, lower the motor, link, sleeve and washer together from above.
steps.pathStatus: Candidate package path tested against open base; right retains the original thin source mating-face contact.

steps.title: Start the four output screws loosely
steps.text: Use the unchanged motor-output holes. Leave them loose until the cheek registers.

steps.title: Close the removable cheek
steps.text: Slide the two straight guide tongues down the open-top side slots. Check that the ring is seated and the orange side closes without force.

steps.title: Retain the removable side
steps.text: Use two black PHS_M2X08_TAP_K screws from above. These lock the side to the base and leave the sleeve free.
steps.pathStatus: TAP screw insertion deliberately engages printed pilot material; threads shown as a cylinder envelope.

steps.title: Seat evenly, then hand snug
steps.text: Check alignment and free manual joint movement with torque off before final tightening. No calibrated torque or physical fit is established here.
fasteners: Finish the previously started 4 output screws; check case/rear retainers

steps.title: Reuse the yellow foot
steps.text: Its original hole and axle interface are retained. Use the existing single foot retainer; follow the main guide for its placement.

sourceScrews.component: Left ankle bracket to combined left foot
sourceScrews.evidence: Derived from actual community 3MF retaining holes: foot through-pilot diameter1.6 through a5mm-long boss; ankle clearance diameter2.2/countersink diameter4.4; head seat to pilot entry2.0mm;4mm engagement leaves1mm of pilot before boss exit. Physical fit not yet verified. This print-to-print fastener was absent from the old motor-joint schedule.

joint.note: Source simulation limits are shown for comparison. Original bracket already collides at some extremes; candidate must not be presented as a collision-free ±90° joint. Motor output horn rotates with ankle, while its case stays with lower; the context mesh includes both.

left.fitNote: New sleeve OD14.6 / ID10.4 / width2.8 mm. Both inner and outer interfaces are sliding clearances; nominal combined radial float about0.4 mm. Captured axially, not glued to the link. Actual printed clearance and stiffness are unverified.
left.statusNote: Digital prototype only. Existing lower link, motor, foot and washer retained; base/cheek/sleeve are replacement prints, not instructions to cut current stock.
left.fastenerSummary: Reuse original 2 case + 1 rear/washer + 4 output + 1 foot screws. Add only 2 black M2×8 TAP (PHS_M2X08_TAP_K) removable-side screws per side.
left.checkSummary: Compare the blocked original bracket with the open-base package approach; fit and movement still require physical checks.

recommendedPrintBedFaces.base: Left local+X/right local-X to bed, per independent print-review. Native supports and material fit remain unverified.
recommendedPrintBedFaces.cheek: NO accepted print orientation. local+Z-down supplied only as a trial; floating large surface and horizontal bearing-ceiling tradeoffs remain. Not print-ready.
recommendedPrintBedFaces.sleeve: one axial annular end flat on bed

parameters.strengthQualification: Threaded pilot rectangular host has at least1.2mm lateral wall before threads, about1.0mm after a2mm outer thread. No four-wall, torque or load-capacity claim.
